user.title: Home Assistant Utils
user.description: Install HA Utils and deploy bundled resources such as themes, packages, and blueprints into your Home Assistant config directory.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Home Assistant Utils is already configured.

user.title: Wind
user.description: Reads a gust sensor and a forecast weather entity. Publishes Level (safe / advisory / warning), Risk, Calm, Gust factor, and Reason. Speeds use the gust sensor's unit; the forecast is converted to it. Fall to safe must be below Rise to advisory, and Fall from warning below Rise to warning.

error.rise_order: Rise to warning must be above Rise to advisory.
error.fall_order: Fall from warning must be above Fall to safe.
error.advisory_gap: Fall to safe must be below Rise to advisory.
error.warning_gap: Fall from warning must be below Rise to warning.

user.title: Temperature
user.description: Merges an optional live temperature sensor with the forecast. Hot and Cold use your lines in the forecast's unit (starting at 90 / 32 °F or 32 / 0 °C). Once on, they clear only after moving Clear margin back past the line.

error.temperature_order: Hot above must be higher than Cold below.

user.title: Bad weather
user.description: Merges an optional live rain sensor with the forecast. Turns on when either one reports bad weather and stays on for Hold for minutes after. A rain total counts while it rose in the last 30 minutes; a rain rate counts while above 0.

signal_source_missing.title: Weather signal is missing a source
signal_source_missing.description: This signal needs {entities}. It stays unavailable until those entities exist again.

signal_source_stale.title: Weather signal source stopped reporting
signal_source_stale.description: {entities} has not reported for {hours} hours. The signal falls back to the forecast until it reports again. Check the device's battery or connection.
